style_guide: Echoes of Gita carousel, 4:5 master (9:16 safe crops). The series moves between modern office life and timeless reflection, unified by one look: muted indigo shadows, warm amber lamplight, and saffron and rose dawn accents. A recurring small brass diya with a soft flame is the visual thread. Photoreal slides use a cinematic 35-50mm lens feel, shallow depth of field, gentle film grain and soft practical lighting. Painterly slides, the sacred and closing images, use warm gouache and oil textures with luminous, reverent light. Every composition is calm and uncluttered, with generous negative space (top or bottom third) for editorial text added later. Any people shown are fictional and non-identifiable. The mood is quiet, empathetic and contemplative, never dramatic. The divine figures Krishna and Arjuna appear only in dignified traditional iconography. No text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks are rendered in any image.

assets.prompt: Cinematic photorealistic split composition at dusk showing two identical modern office desks side by side under warm lamplight, each with an open laptop and a ceramic cup of tea. The left desk is cluttered and tense: blank sticky notes scattered, tangled cables, papers askew, a harsher cool cast. The right desk carries the same workload neatly arranged, with a small brass diya glowing softly beside the laptop and a warm, settled feel. No people. Eye-level frontal framing, 35mm lens, symmetrical layout with a subtle central divide. Muted indigo and amber palette, soft film grain. Large empty dark negative space across the top third. Mood: quiet contrast, curiosity.
assets.negative_prompt: text, letters, words, writing on sticky notes, numbers, logos, watermark, people, faces, celebrity likeness, political symbols, harsh neon, oversaturated colors, cartoon style

assets.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic scene late at night in a dim open-plan office. A fictional South Asian professional woman in her early thirties, in simple business-casual clothing, sits alone at her desk. Only her desk lamp is lit, casting a warm pool of amber light, and blurred city lights glow through the large window behind her. She rests her chin on her hand and gazes at her laptop screen with tired, thoughtful eyes. A plain analog wall clock with hands near twenty to ten is softly out of focus, with no numerals. Three-quarter side angle, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, gentle empathetic lighting. Deep indigo shadows against warm lamp tones, soft film grain. Empty dark space in the upper area. Mood: weary, quiet, human.
assets.negative_prompt: text, numerals on clock, letters, readable screen content, logos, watermark, real person, celebrity likeness, recognisable face of a public figure, political symbols, crying melodrama, sexualised pose, distorted hands, extra fingers

assets.prompt: Painterly, reverent illustration in traditional Indian devotional iconography, warm gouache and oil texture. Krishna, blue-complexioned and serene, wears a peacock-feather crown, yellow silk garments and gold ornaments. He sits as charioteer on an ornate wooden chariot and turns gently toward Arjuna, who wears princely attire and listens with folded hands and a humble, attentive expression. Four white horses stand calmly at rest. The Kurukshetra plain stretches far behind, with distant armies only as soft, hazy silhouettes on the horizon. A golden dawn sky glows with luminous light around the figures. Medium-wide composition, eye level, figures in the upper two-thirds, open soft ground and sky in the lower third. Palette of saffron, gold, soft blue and cream. Mood: calm, luminous, dignified, sacred.
assets.negative_prompt: undignified depiction of Krishna or Arjuna, non-traditional iconography, sexualised depiction, comedic depiction, cartoon or meme style, caricature, violence, gore, blood, graphic injury, weapons raised in combat, close-up battle, real living people, celebrity likeness, political symbols, text, letters, logos, watermark, distorted anatomy, extra limbs
